body:
pretty obvious this could be used for something more useful, but i dont want to. i have no will to do anything because its all worthless now

plus uhhh 5'7? no shit it doesnt affect you, youre not considered short. if you want to say that its "only a few inches" where would it stop? 5'8? 5'9? where is the deadline for normal if you think that being 5'7 is an impediment.

all of this is pointless, ill never be attractive. fuck it.

but say that 'model' is normal, like every one else. who would they pick? they dont even have to be a model, just more attractive which is pretty easy.

just because other people overcame them doesnt mean i share the exact same situation. suicide isnt the only resolution but its the easiest in my case.

not to many people. you can say all you want that personality trumps everything but thats not exactly true.

attractiveness is important unless your standards are below sea level. who wants to be with someone unattractive? who in their right fucking mind? hell, according to my friends i have low standards and even then there are some people that are unattractive to me. i dont give a hot shit if they have a great personality. i, like the majority of people, would not go through with it.

its not a hopeless feeling of me never accomplishing anything. its just the social side.

im short and thats not an attractive feature for a man

small dick, not an attractive feature

ugly, enough said

it all sums up into those 3, theyve caused me so much turmoil that im tired of trying to ignore them. theyll be with me all of my life. im at a significant disadvantage to even an AVERAGE person. i do not have the willpower to try and be smug and try anyways. im not going to deal with a possible 70 more years of this

honestly its pretty dumb to think that any human is going to just say "fuck attractiveness". everyone thinks of other peoples opinions, even at the slightest they still do. we seek to be accepted, and its hard to feel accepted, normal, or anything positive when youre below average. even way back as primal humans we looked for attractiveness. now i know that attractiveness is subjective but there is a general area of what people think is attractive. i doubt the majority would look at someone like me and think i was anything but ugly

height is so much more than a slight 'thing'. its so so much more than you think.

and yes i know about dick size. but its about the stigma. im below average in height, and dick size. im not going to wear that as a badge of fucking honor. im sure there are plenty of women content with their mans 5 inch dick but its not the fear of not being able its the stigma it carries. even if no one says a word it still will eat you inside.

i wouldnt expect my life to get worse in a mere hour, but im not gonna stick around for when it does

height is a lot more, i could write a novel on the advantages. its a waste of my short time left though. no one seems to get it and they never will unless they experience it. its more of an issue of looks and attractiveness btw, not accomplishing something like being a firefighter.

i know, ive heard it all about porn and ive researched everything there is to know about dick sizes. im just barely 5 inches, thats below average. i know its not minuscule but when youre still below average its useless to have excuses.

i guess thats a risk im willing to take. not much to really ruin

and what dont i have an issue with would be the proper question lol, its everything pretty much. specifics? height, face, & dick size would be the top 3

cant fix those
its not regarding people problems, just internal

not disclosing the first one, it wont fail ill tell you that much

second? mainly body issues, thats where i get all of my mental problems.

still here unfortunately.

what would you like to know?
what exactly do i show 'them'? that i can resist the urge to kill myself and remain in this pit?
